properties.title: Bulgaria faces EU fine over runaway public finances
properties.summary: BRUSSELS — The European Commission on Tuesday threatened to slap a fine worth up to €23 million on Bulgaria for failing to rein in spending. But Budapest’s punishment would be limited to frozen EU funds, as fines of up to 0.02% of GDP are reserved for countries within the single currency union. properties.title: Was it a lion? Grainy footage prompted a large search in Istanbul
properties.summary: Reports of a lioness roaming north of Istanbul prompted a security scramble after grainy footage appeared to show a large cat prowling across open land. Following a day of searches, Turkish authorities said the animal was neither a lion nor any other big cat.
